title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables/Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductors for Working Voltages up to and Including 450/750 V — Specification (Fourth Revision)
scope: Covers requirements for single and multi-core PVC cables for electric power and lighting.

clauses.title: Conductor
clauses.content: Conductors shall be of plain or tinned annealed high conductivity copper or aluminium wires complying with IS 8130.

clauses.title: Insulation Thickness
clauses.content: Insulation shall be PVC Type A or Type C compound complying with IS 5831, applied continuously by extrusion.

clauses.title: High Voltage Test
clauses.content: Cables shall withstand an AC voltage of 2.0 kV rms for 15 minutes between conductors without breakdown.
